name: Delete an image manifest
description: Delete an image manifest DELETE /v2/:teamSlug/:projectSlug/:repositoryName/manifests/:reference Reference must be a digest. DELETE /v2/{teamSlug}/{projectSlug}/{repositoryName}/manifests/{reference}

name: Pull an image manifest
description: Pull an image manifest GET /v2/:teamSlug/:projectSlug/:repositoryName/manifests/:reference Fetch a manifest by tag or digest. GET /v2/{teamSlug}/{projectSlug}/{repositoryName}/manifests/{reference}

name: Push an image manifest
description: Push an image manifest PUT /v2/:teamSlug/:projectSlug/:repositoryName/manifests/:reference Upload an image manifest. PUT /v2/{teamSlug}/{projectSlug}/{repositoryName}/manifests/{reference}
